A fully decorated, professional studio space in Budapest—perfect for your seasonal photoshoots.

Book the Photo Studio

A Festive and Professional Space for Your Christmas Photoshoots

Located in the heart of Budapest, our fully equipped and Christmas-decorated studio offers everything a photographer needs to create stunning holiday photos. From cozy backdrops and festive props to professional lighting and high-end gear, we’ve created a seasonal setting that makes holiday photoshoots effortless and beautiful.

  • Beautiful Christmas decor, including two trees, fairy lights, and holiday props
  • Professional lighting, backdrops, and essential equipment provided
  • Flexible booking options, ideal for single sessions or full-day rentals
  • Convenient central Budapest location with easy access and ample space

Everything You Need for a Seamless Holiday Shoot

Our studio is designed to support photographers in creating stunning holiday portraits, family sessions, and group photos without the hassle of setting up. From lights to decor, we’ve taken care of every detail so you can focus on capturing perfect moments.

  • Holiday Decor: 2 Christmas trees, gift boxes, festive wreaths, and cozy furniture
  • Professional Equipment: Softbox lights, backdrops, reflectors, and more
  • High-Speed Wi-Fi: Easily connect and share your work on-site
  • Changing Room and Waiting Area: Space for clients to prepare comfortably
  • Props: Available for family sessions, couples, and individual portraits

We offer a range of rental packages so you can choose what works best for your holiday schedule. Whether you’re looking for a quick setup or an extended session, our packages are designed to provide value and flexibility.
